root_turn.title: Synthetic John 1:5 page fixture and region-grounded evidence

objective: Persist the exact frozen VS01-T06 design and authority erratum; mechanically characterize the exact T03-bound Source Serif objects and the ChatGPT-selected linux/amd64 Python/Pillow renderer; implement four strict page-fixture contracts; generate and commit one clean and one degraded deterministic John 1:5 PNG fixture plus realized metadata; implement read-only verification and receipt-last archive publication behavior; prove exact reproduction, source/authority separation, visual acceptance, and no-write canonical dry-run behavior; then open one draft PR for ChatGPT exact-head and visual review.
activated_user_visible_capability: The repository contains a public-safe synthetic John 1:5 study page and a degraded illegibility variant with exact region ground truth, and the CLI can verify or dry-run publication of those immutable fixture bytes without OCR, VLM, model inference, or database mutation.
